title: Cyrus and the Echo Anew
author: Ulyana Blackwood
blurb: Juniper Thackeray, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
